claims.text: This excerpt shows the initialization and startup of the TrustedInstaller service, which is part of the Windows Component-Based Servicing (CBS) system.
The logs indicate that the WcpInitialize function was called multiple times with different stack traces, and then the TrustedInstaller service started its main loop and initialized successfully.
The logs also mention the initialization of Software Quality Metrics (SQM) with Windows opt-in set to False and the cleaning up of old report files.
